reqs.name: Basin-wide collection
reqs.statement: The system shall collect sensor reports from designated deployment locations within the Congo River Basin service area.
reqs.threshold: Evaluate 100% of the designated trial-site inventory against a georeferenced coverage map spanning the 3.7 million km² basin; report supported/unsupported sites and terrain/canopy class (RFP S3-01 area; proposed verification method).
reqs.rationale: The system must provide geographically extensive data collection capabilities to support environmental monitoring throughout the basin.

reqs.name: Priority Data Delivery
reqs.statement: The system shall prioritize designated time-critical sensor messages over routine sensor messages when communication capacity is constrained.
reqs.threshold: Time-critical messages assigned priority over routine sensor traffic; end-to-end performance allocated to L2-1.2.3.
reqs.rationale: Critical environmental conditions, such as rapid river level increases, may require immediate attention.

reqs.name: Low-Power Terminals
reqs.statement: The system shall support autonomous sensor-terminal operation for at least one year without battery replacement or external grid power under the specified reporting duty cycle.
reqs.threshold: ≥1 year (RFP S3-04); objective ≥3 years
reqs.rationale: Aligns minimum autonomous lifetime with RFP S3-04; a five-year goal would be an unapproved stretch target.

reqs.name: Data Integrity
reqs.statement: The system shall detect corrupted sensor messages before delivering them to the designated data collection endpoint.
reqs.threshold: At least 99% detection of corrupted messages under defined test conditions.
reqs.rationale: Environmental monitoring data must be trustworthy, particularly when used to initiate emergency alerts.

reqs.name: Store-and-Forward
reqs.statement: The system shall retain sensor messages during loss of an available onward communication path and forward them when a suitable path becomes available.
reqs.threshold: Retain 100% of accepted messages over a simulated 24 h onward-path outage at the declared peak arrival rate; verify ordered replay after recovery (proposed; overflow must be separately logged).
reqs.rationale: A single 100-message figure is not adequate for all sensor/repeater/station roles; buffering depends on assigned terminals, message rate, outage window, and priority.

reqs.name: Under-Canopy Connectivity
reqs.statement: The system shall deliver at least one valid test sensor message from each successful under-canopy trial location to the designated collection endpoint during the approved observation period.
reqs.threshold: ≥90% of representative designated under-canopy trial sites achieve ≥1 valid end-to-end delivery over a 24 h trial (proposed 90% site metric; RFP S3-01 requires basin service including under canopy).
reqs.rationale: Dense vegetation can significantly attenuate radio-frequency signals, making communication difficult.

reqs.name: Sensor Network Capacity
reqs.statement: The system shall support simultaneous registration and scheduled data collection from at least 10,000 geographically distributed sensor terminals.
reqs.threshold: ≥10,000 active registered terminals; ≥2 kB routine payload per terminal/day (RFP S3-02)
reqs.rationale: The network must accommodate large numbers of environmental sensors throughout the Congo River Basin.

reqs.name: Data Delivery
reqs.statement: The system shall deliver accepted routine sensor messages to designated data endpoints within the approved routine reporting interval.
reqs.threshold: ≥99% of accepted routine sensor messages delivered within ≤24 h of source acceptance under nominal connected operation (proposed; priority traffic retains ≤30 min at ≥95% per RFP S3-03).
reqs.rationale: Must distinguish accepted messages from total generated messages and distinguish routine delivery from RFP priority delivery.

reqs.name: Multi-Path Data Collection
reqs.statement: The system shall support sensor-data transport using both direct satellite and terrestrial relay communication path types.
reqs.threshold: Both direct satellite and terrestrial relay paths supported; not every terminal requires both radios.
reqs.rationale: Multiple communication paths increase coverage and provide alternatives when direct satellite links are obstructed.

reqs.name: Alert transmission
reqs.statement: The system shall cause an authorized alert to be reproduced audibly at 95% or more of targeted community receivers within 10 minutes of alert acceptance.
reqs.threshold: ≤10 min to audible playback for ≥95% of targeted community receivers (RFP S3-05); objective ≤3 min for ≥99%
reqs.rationale: Establishes the alert transmission capability.

reqs.name: Geographic targeting
reqs.statement: The system shall support geographically targeted alert distribution to individually selected communities or groups of communities.
reqs.threshold: Targetable geographic alert area ≤50,000 km² (RFP S3-06); objective ≤2,500 km²
reqs.rationale: Ensures alerts reach the intended geographic areas.

reqs.name: Audible spoken alerts
reqs.statement: The system shall make geographically targeted emergency alerts available as audible spoken messages at designated community receivers.
reqs.threshold: 100% of approved spoken-alert test messages shall be played in the configured language; audibility test at 1 m in a quiet reference environment (proposed test condition); community-scale acoustic reach requires site survey.
reqs.rationale: Establishes the need for community receivers and spoken alerts.

reqs.name: Reception confirmation
reqs.statement: The system shall maintain and report an acknowledgment state for each addressed community receiver for each authorized alert.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Provides operational confirmation without claiming that a human heard or understood the message.

reqs.name: Independent of terrestrial networks
reqs.statement: The system shall distribute authorized alerts through a satellite-supported path when existing public terrestrial telecommunications networks are unavailable.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Establishes independence from existing infrastructure.

reqs.name: Alert authorization
reqs.statement: The system shall prevent unauthorized users from initiating emergency alert broadcasts.
reqs.threshold: 100% rejection of unauthorized requests in a defined authentication test suite.
reqs.rationale: Prevents false emergency broadcasts and malicious use of the network.

reqs.name: Alert Prioritization
reqs.statement: The system shall prioritize emergency alert traffic over routine sensor data transmissions when communication capacity is constrained.
reqs.threshold: Emergency alerts assigned the highest network scheduling priority.
reqs.rationale: Emergency alerts should not be delayed by routine environmental monitoring.

reqs.name: Alert Language Support
reqs.statement: The system shall support the transmission and reproduction of emergency alerts in the designated languages of each participating community.
reqs.threshold: French, Lingala, Kiswahili, Kikongo, Tshiluba (RFP S3-06); objective ≥10 district-selected languages
reqs.rationale: Emergency alerts must be understandable to their intended recipients.

reqs.name: Responder two-way comms
reqs.statement: The system shall provide two-way communications between registered ranger or responder terminals and designated coordination authorities.
reqs.threshold: ≥500 simultaneous terminals at ≥4.8 kbps each (RFP S3-08); objective ≥5,000 at ≥64 kbps
reqs.rationale: Provides responder communication capability in remote areas.

reqs.name: Commands and acknowledgments
reqs.statement: The system shall deliver authorized commands and acknowledgments to addressed responder terminals within the required delivery interval.
reqs.threshold: ≤6 hours (RFP S3-09); objective ≤15 minutes
reqs.rationale: Closes the command and acknowledgment loop for coordination.

reqs.name: Survives terrestrial outages
reqs.statement: The system shall support responder communications when existing terrestrial communications infrastructure is unavailable.
reqs.threshold: ≥99.5% service availability in the defined heavy-tropical-rain environment and ≥10-year service life; objectives ≥99.9% and ≥15 years (RFP S3-10). Demonstrate terrestrial carrier outage continuity over proposed 24 h test.
reqs.rationale: Maintains coordination during flood, conflict, or infrastructure failures.

reqs.name: Responder Distress Messaging
reqs.statement: The system shall accept a distress message initiated by an authorized responder terminal and route it to the configured emergency coordination endpoint.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Supports emergency assistance requests from remote ranger personnel.

reqs.name: Responder Location Reporting
reqs.statement: The system shall forward responder location reports containing a valid position estimate and acquisition timestamp to authorized coordination endpoints.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% of approved event-to-event timing trials complete within ≤120 s under the declared nominal connected scenario (proposed); specify the start/end events and exclude satellite visibility wait only where explicitly stated.
reqs.rationale: Supports dispatch and situational awareness without requiring GNSS at all times.

reqs.name: Responder Message Status
reqs.statement: The system shall display the current delivery state for each responder message requiring confirmation.
reqs.threshold: Demonstrate essential operation for ≥24 h at the declared load with no solar input (proposed fixed-installation reference); record Wh, W and duty cycle; sensor terminal lifetime separately remains ≥1 year (RFP S3-04).
reqs.rationale: Distinguishes accepted-by-network from received-at-destination.

reqs.name: Responder Traffic Priority
reqs.statement: The system shall schedule authorized distress messages ahead of routine sensor telemetry when both are queued for the same constrained communication resource.
reqs.threshold: Retain 100% of accepted messages over a simulated 24 h onward-path outage at the declared peak arrival rate; verify ordered replay after recovery (proposed; overflow must be separately logged).
reqs.rationale: Allocates scarce communications resources to emergency responder needs.

reqs.name: Responder Terminal Mobility
reqs.statement: The system shall re-establish a supported communications session after a responder terminal enters an approved coverage region.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Ranger patrol teams operate away from fixed stations.

reqs.name: Service area
reqs.statement: The system shall provide sensor-data collection service within the service area defined for the Congo River Basin, including designated under-canopy locations.
reqs.threshold: Evaluate 100% of the designated trial-site inventory against a georeferenced coverage map spanning the 3.7 million km² basin; report supported/unsupported sites and terrain/canopy class (RFP S3-01 area; proposed verification method).
reqs.rationale: Defines the geographical boundaries of the communications network.

reqs.name: Sensor Terminal Connectivity
reqs.statement: The network shall support routine data transport for at least 10,000 registered sensor terminals, each generating at least 2 kB of application payload per 24 hours.
reqs.threshold: ≥10,000 terminals × ≥2 kB/terminal/24 h (RFP S3-02); objective ≥100,000 × ≥50 kB/terminal/24 h.
reqs.rationale: Establishes the ability of sensor terminals to communicate with the network.

reqs.name: Sensor Message Reception
reqs.statement: The collection network shall accept valid sensor messages from registered terminals through an available supported communication path.
reqs.threshold: 100% of valid registered-terminal messages accepted and logged with terminal ID and reception timestamp in the approved interface test suite.
reqs.rationale: Ensures the network can receive sensor data.

reqs.name: Message Priority Classification
reqs.statement: The network shall classify received sensor messages according to the priority field assigned by an authorized sensor terminal or application.
reqs.threshold: Every approved test message classified as routine or priority according to its authenticated class field; two classes minimum.
reqs.rationale: Message classification capability enabling priority scheduling; RFP S3-03 applies to end-to-end delivery at L2-1.2.3.

reqs.name: Priority Message Scheduling
reqs.statement: The network scheduler shall allocate service to priority-class sensor messages before routine-class messages when both contend for constrained capacity.
reqs.threshold: Priority message selected ahead of routine message at the next available non-preemptive scheduling opportunity in every approved contention trial.
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Priority Message Delivery
reqs.statement: The system shall deliver priority sensor messages to the designated common operating picture within 30 minutes for at least 95% of qualifying messages.
reqs.threshold: ≤30 min for ≥95% (RFP S3-03); objective ≤5 min for ≥99%
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Sensor Terminal Lifetime
reqs.statement: The sensor terminal shall meet the RFP operating-life and unit-cost limits for the specified sensor configuration.
reqs.threshold: ≥1 year operating life and ≤$150 per unit (RFP S3-04); objectives ≥3 years / ≤$50
reqs.rationale: RFP Level 0 requirement S3-04, values verbatim. Placement in this tree is proposed (TBR).

reqs.name: Low-Power Operating Modes
reqs.statement: The sensor terminal shall enter a reduced-power state between scheduled sensing and communication events.
reqs.threshold: Demonstrate essential operation for ≥24 h at the declared load with no solar input (proposed fixed-installation reference); record Wh, W and duty cycle; sensor terminal lifetime separately remains ≥1 year (RFP S3-04).
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Transmission Energy Consumption
reqs.statement: The sensor terminal shall operate within the energy budget allocated to message transmission during the specified reporting duty cycle.
reqs.threshold: Average terminal energy consumption ≤ annual usable battery energy divided by 365 days, including transmit, receive, sleep, and retries; ≥1-year terminal life (RFP S3-04); battery chemistry/capacity must be declared per candidate design.
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Message error detection
reqs.statement: The data-ingest subsystem shall check received sensor messages for transmission errors before accepting their payloads.
reqs.threshold: Error detection ≥99% under defined corruption test set (allocated from L1-1.4)
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Data integrity reporting
reqs.statement: The data-ingest subsystem shall record integrity-check failures for rejected sensor messages.
reqs.threshold: Every rejected corruption-test message produces a log entry containing terminal ID, reception timestamp, and failure reason.
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Message identification
reqs.statement: Each sensor message shall contain a terminal identifier and a message identifier sufficient to distinguish its origin and sequence.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Duplicate Message Detection
reqs.statement: The data-ingest subsystem shall detect retransmitted duplicates using message identity before forwarding a measurement as a new observation.
reqs.threshold: No retransmitted duplicate in the approved replay test suite creates an additional observation.
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Sensor Message Buffering
reqs.statement: Sensor terminals and relay nodes designated for buffering shall retain accepted messages while their onward communication path is unavailable.
reqs.threshold: Nonvolatile buffer holds ≥24 h of the node’s design peak accepted traffic without loss; design arrival rate and message size documented per node (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Terminal, repeater, and ranger-station arrival rates can differ by orders of magnitude; capacity is assigned after scenario analysis.

reqs.name: Deferred Message Transmission
reqs.statement: A buffering node shall attempt delivery of queued sensor messages when an authorized onward link becomes available.
reqs.threshold: Retain 100% of accepted messages over a simulated 24 h onward-path outage at the declared peak arrival rate; verify ordered replay after recovery (proposed; overflow must be separately logged).
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Buffer Management
reqs.statement: A buffering node shall apply a defined queue-retention and overflow policy when its storage limit is reached.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Under-Canopy Communication
reqs.statement: The sensor communications network shall provide at least one supported communication path for designated sensor terminals positioned beneath forest canopy.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Canopy Penetration Performance
reqs.statement: The under-canopy communication link shall satisfy its specified receiver sensitivity margin under the designated canopy propagation test conditions.
reqs.threshold: ≥6 dB received-signal margin at ≥90% of representative under-canopy trial locations under the defined test waveform and canopy conditions (proposed design allocation, not field-validated).
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Under-Canopy Message Reliability
reqs.statement: The system shall deliver messages from at least 90% of designated under-canopy test locations during a defined observation period.
reqs.threshold: ≥90% of designated test locations (allocated L1-1.6)
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Terminal Registration Capacity
reqs.statement: The network management subsystem shall register and maintain identity and configuration information for at least 10,000 active sensor terminals.
reqs.threshold: ≥10,000 registered terminals; objective ≥100,000 (RFP S3-02)
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Network Message Capacity
reqs.statement: The network shall transport the aggregate routine application payload generated by the supported sensor population during each 24-hour reporting interval.
reqs.threshold: ≥20,000,000 bytes of routine application payload per 24 h at 10,000 × 2,000 bytes/day; objective ≥5,000,000,000 bytes/day at 100,000 × 50,000 bytes/day (decimal kB assumption; protocol overhead additional).
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Communication Resource Allocation
reqs.statement: The network control subsystem shall allocate communication opportunities among registered terminals according to a documented access policy.
reqs.threshold: Demonstrate fair access and scheduled reporting for ≥10,000 registered terminals generating ≥2 kB/terminal/day; objective ≥100,000 terminals at ≥50 kB/day (RFP S3-02); verify burst scheduling with declared load model.
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Ground Data Delivery
reqs.statement: The ground segment shall forward accepted sensor payloads to the designated monitoring or common operating picture data endpoint.
reqs.threshold: Every accepted test payload arrives at the designated monitoring endpoint with matching message ID and payload integrity.
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Message Delivery Latency
reqs.statement: The system shall time-stamp sensor-message receipt and endpoint delivery to determine end-to-end delivery latency.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% of approved event-to-event timing trials complete within ≤120 s under the declared nominal connected scenario (proposed); specify the start/end events and exclude satellite visibility wait only where explicitly stated.
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Delivery Status Reporting
reqs.statement: The system shall make available a delivery status for accepted sensor messages to authorized operators.
reqs.threshold: Every accepted test message exposes one of delivered, pending, or failed states to an authorized operator.
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Direct Satellite Uplink
reqs.statement: The system shall accept messages transmitted directly from compatible satellite-capable sensor terminals.
reqs.threshold: Successful direct-satellite transfer from at least one compatible test terminal to the designated endpoint in the approved coverage scenario.
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Terrestrial Relay Communication
reqs.statement: The system shall accept messages originating from sensor terminals through compatible terrestrial repeater or gateway nodes.
reqs.threshold: Successful terrestrial-relay transfer from at least one compatible test terminal to the designated endpoint in the approved coverage scenario.
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Ranger Station Connectivity
reqs.statement: Designated ranger stations shall receive sensor messages from compatible local sensors or relays and provide an onward route to a monitoring endpoint.
reqs.threshold: Successful local sensor reception and onward forwarding at every designated ranger-station configuration in the approved integration test.
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Communication Path Selection
reqs.statement: A dual-interface network node shall select an available authorized alternate path when its active onward communication path becomes unavailable.
reqs.threshold: Switch to an available alternate authorized path within ≤60 s in ≥95% of failover trials; exclude intervals when no alternate path is physically available (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Relay Message Forwarding
reqs.statement: Terrestrial relay nodes shall forward accepted sensor messages to an authorized neighbor, ranger station, or satellite gateway.
reqs.threshold: Successful payload and identifier preservation through every configured relay-hop count in the approved route test suite.
reqs.rationale: Allocated implementation capability required to fulfill the parent system requirement.

reqs.name: Alert Intake
reqs.statement: The ground segment shall accept emergency alert requests submitted by authorized alerting authorities.
reqs.threshold: Each valid authorized test request accepted and logged with submitter identity and receipt timestamp; invalid/unauthorized requests rejected.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Broadcast Distribution
reqs.statement: The space and ground communications network shall deliver each accepted alert payload to its designated community receiver group within the allocated distribution interval.
reqs.threshold: ≤5 min from acceptance by the broadcast gateway to receipt of the authorized alert payload at ≥95% of targeted receivers; preliminary allocation within RFP S3-05 end-to-end ≤10 min.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Alert Validation
reqs.statement: The alert control service shall validate required alert fields and issue a rejection status for an incomplete or invalid submission.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L1-2.1.

reqs.name: Target Group Resolution
reqs.statement: The alert distribution service shall resolve a geographically defined authorized alert into the set of registered community receivers assigned to that region.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Receiver Group Assignment
reqs.statement: The alert addressing service shall associate each registered community receiver with a designated geographic service area.
reqs.threshold: Evaluate 100% of the designated trial-site inventory against a georeferenced coverage map spanning the 3.7 million km² basin; report supported/unsupported sites and terrain/canopy class (RFP S3-01 area; proposed verification method).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L1-2.2.

reqs.name: Out-of-Area Exclusion
reqs.statement: The alert distribution service shall exclude registered receivers outside the approved alert region unless an authorized override explicitly includes them.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L1-2.2.

reqs.name: Spoken Alert Playback
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall reproduce an accepted alert payload as intelligible spoken audio.
reqs.threshold: 100% of accepted, addressed alert payloads initiate audible playback within ≤60 s of valid receiver reception; preliminary allocation within the 2 min receiver-processing/audio budget.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Alert Payload Reception
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall accept authorized addressed alert payloads from the communications network.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L1-2.3.

reqs.name: Receiver Energy Supply
reqs.statement: The community alert receiver shall operate from at least one permitted off-grid energy source without requiring external grid power.
reqs.threshold: Off-grid power via solar OR hand-crank and receiver unit cost ≤$25; objective ≤$10 or reception on existing phones (RFP S3-07). Proposed test: ≥3 successive 60 s audio alerts without grid power.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L1-2.3.

reqs.name: Reception Acknowledgment
reqs.statement: Community receiver equipment shall generate a reception acknowledgment when it successfully accepts an alert, using the specified acknowledgment interface.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Acknowledgment Return Path
reqs.statement: The system shall provide a communications path for transmitting community reception acknowledgments to the alert control service.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% of acknowledgments generated by successfully receiving test units arrive at the monitoring endpoint within ≤5 min of playback, under the approved connected return-path scenario (proposed; not an RFP delivery target).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Acknowledgment Monitoring
reqs.statement: The alert control service shall identify targeted receivers for which a reception acknowledgment has not been recorded by the defined deadline.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% of approved event-to-event timing trials complete within ≤120 s under the declared nominal connected scenario (proposed); specify the start/end events and exclude satellite visibility wait only where explicitly stated.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Acknowledgment Correlation
reqs.statement: The alert reporting service shall correlate each valid acknowledgment to exactly one alert identifier and one receiver identifier.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct association for valid acknowledgments and rejection of malformed or unmatched identifiers in the approved test suite.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L1-2.4.

reqs.name: Independent Alert Path
reqs.statement: The alert communications system shall provide a satellite-based path to designated communities during loss of terrestrial communications infrastructure.
reqs.threshold: Complete a broadcast trial with external terrestrial carrier networks disconnected for ≥24 h; ≥95% of targeted receivers audible within ≤10 min for each authorized trial alert (RFP S3-05; proposed 24 h outage).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Satellite Gateway Continuity
reqs.statement: The ground segment shall route authorized alert traffic through the satellite network when public terrestrial telecommunications paths are unavailable.
reqs.threshold: Ground-to-satellite gateway maintains alert submission during a ≥24 h simulated external terrestrial carrier outage; 100% of valid test alerts accepted for onward routing (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L1-2.5.

reqs.name: Operator Authentication
reqs.statement: The alert control service shall authenticate each operator before permitting the operator to initiate an alert.
reqs.threshold: Reject every unauthenticated operator attempt in the approved negative-test suite; authorize valid roles per approved access matrix.
reqs.rationale: Supports prevention of unauthorized community emergency broadcasts.

reqs.name: Alert Message Authentication
reqs.statement: The alert control service shall verify the origin and integrity of each received alert request before broadcast acceptance.
reqs.threshold: Reject all alert requests with invalid origin credentials or altered authenticated payloads in the approved test suite.
reqs.rationale: Supports prevention of unauthorized community emergency broadcasts.

reqs.name: Unauthorized Transmission Rejection
reqs.statement: The alert distribution service shall reject alert broadcast requests that do not satisfy the active authorization policy.
reqs.threshold: 100% rejection in defined negative-test suite
reqs.rationale: Supports prevention of unauthorized community emergency broadcasts.

reqs.name: Alert Traffic Queue
reqs.statement: The network scheduler shall maintain emergency alert traffic separately from routine sensor-message traffic.
reqs.threshold: At least two independently distinguishable queues: emergency alerts and routine sensor traffic.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Alert Preemption
reqs.statement: The network scheduler shall give eligible emergency alert traffic precedence over routine sensor traffic during contention.
reqs.threshold: Emergency alert selected before routine sensor traffic at the next available non-preemptive scheduling opportunity in every contention trial.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Alert Queue Recovery
reqs.statement: The message scheduler shall preserve untransmitted emergency alert messages during temporary link interruption and resume eligible transmissions after link restoration.
reqs.threshold: Retain 100% of accepted messages over a simulated 24 h onward-path outage at the declared peak arrival rate; verify ordered replay after recovery (proposed; overflow must be separately logged).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L1-2.7.

reqs.name: Language Assignment
reqs.statement: The alert control service shall associate each participating community with its designated alert language or languages.
reqs.threshold: 100% of registered test communities have at least one designated alert language stored in their profile.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Spoken Language Delivery
reqs.statement: The alert delivery chain shall distribute alert audio or equivalent spoken-language content in the language selected for each targeted community.
reqs.threshold: French plus four listed languages at threshold (RFP S3-06)
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Language Payload Selection
reqs.statement: The alert delivery service shall select the approved spoken-language payload for each addressed community based on its stored language assignment.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct payload-to-community mapping across all five threshold languages in the approved language-routing test suite (RFP S3-06).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L1-2.8.

reqs.name: Responder Session Setup
reqs.statement: The communications network shall establish uplink and downlink communication sessions for authorized responder terminals.
reqs.threshold: ≥500 simultaneous sessions at ≥4.8 kbps each (RFP S3-08)
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Responder Terminal Interface
reqs.statement: A responder terminal shall transmit and receive communications through an approved satellite or supported relay interface.
reqs.threshold: Successful authorized uplink and downlink exchange via each supported terminal interface in the approved integration test.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Coordination Endpoint Interface
reqs.statement: The ground segment shall connect responder traffic with the designated coordination endpoint.
reqs.threshold: Bidirectional exchange of addressed test messages between responder network and designated coordination endpoint.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.

reqs.name: Responder Addressing
reqs.statement: The network shall maintain an addressable identity for each registered responder terminal.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L1-3.1.

reqs.name: Command Routing
reqs.statement: The network shall route an authorized command toward its addressed responder terminal.
reqs.threshold: Every authorized addressed test command routed to its intended terminal in the approved coverage scenarios; latency per RFP S3-09.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability supporting the parent requirement.
