reqs.rationale: Allocates the Responder Addressing requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Command Destination Resolution
reqs.statement: The routing service shall resolve each accepted command to the intended responder terminal identifier.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Command Routing requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Command Forwarding Interface
reqs.statement: The satellite or relay forwarding node shall forward an accepted command toward its resolved destination.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Command Routing requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Command Receipt Detection
reqs.statement: The responder terminal shall identify a complete received command requiring acknowledgment.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of the approved nominal, boundary and fault-injection functional test cases with logged inputs, outputs and acceptance decisions (proposed verification criterion).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Responder Acknowledgment requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Acknowledgment Transmission
reqs.statement: The responder terminal shall transmit a command acknowledgment referencing the corresponding command identifier.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Responder Acknowledgment requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Pending Command Queue
reqs.statement: The command service shall retain commands awaiting terminal connectivity.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Deferred Command Delivery requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Queued Command Retry
reqs.statement: The command service shall retry eligible queued commands when the addressed terminal becomes reachable.
reqs.threshold: Retain 100% of accepted messages over a simulated 24 h onward-path outage at the declared peak arrival rate; verify ordered replay after recovery (proposed; overflow must be separately logged).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Deferred Command Delivery requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Command Origin Check
reqs.statement: The routing service shall validate the issuing authority of a command before queuing it for delivery.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Command Authentication requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Unauthorized Command Rejection
reqs.statement: The routing service shall reject and record commands that fail authorization validation.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Command Authentication requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Satellite Outage Fallback
reqs.statement: The network shall provide a supported satellite communications route for responder messages when terrestrial carrier service is unavailable.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Terrestrial Outage Operation requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Outage Path Verification
reqs.statement: The network gateway shall report operational status for the supported satellite responder path during a terrestrial outage.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Terrestrial Outage Operation requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Rain Link Margin
reqs.statement: The communications link design shall provide the rain-fade margin needed to meet its allocated service availability budget.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of the approved nominal, boundary and fault-injection functional test cases with logged inputs, outputs and acceptance decisions (proposed verification criterion).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Rain Availability requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Rain Availability Monitoring
reqs.statement: The service monitoring subsystem shall log communications availability during the specified tropical rain test profile.
reqs.threshold: ≥99.5% system service availability in the declared heavy-tropical-rain test profile; objective ≥99.9% (RFP S3-10); calculate using declared service-time denominator and rainfall model.
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Rain Availability requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Outdoor Equipment Protection
reqs.statement: Permanent outdoor ground communications equipment shall maintain its required operation under the site environmental exposure profile.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of the approved nominal, boundary and fault-injection functional test cases with logged inputs, outputs and acceptance decisions (proposed verification criterion).
reqs.rationale: Rain availability needs both radio fade performance and resilient ground equipment.

reqs.name: Equipment Life Allocation
reqs.statement: The system design shall allocate service-life targets to maintainable communications equipment.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of the approved nominal, boundary and fault-injection functional test cases with logged inputs, outputs and acceptance decisions (proposed verification criterion).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the System Service Life requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Replacement Provisioning
reqs.statement: The operations plan shall specify replacement or maintenance actions necessary to sustain the required mission service duration.
reqs.threshold: ≥10 years service life by reliability/life-cycle analysis with stated maintenance assumptions; objective ≥15 years (RFP S3-10).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the System Service Life requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Ranger Gateway Backhaul Switch
reqs.statement: The ranger station gateway shall activate a supported satellite backhaul when its primary terrestrial backhaul fails.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Alternative Backhaul requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Ranger Backhaul Recovery
reqs.statement: The ranger gateway shall resume forwarding queued responder traffic after satellite backhaul is established.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Alternative Backhaul requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Ranger Station Backup Energy
reqs.statement: The permanent ranger-station communications subsystem shall provide battery-supported operation of its satellite backhaul during loss of available solar generation.
reqs.threshold: Demonstrate essential operation for ≥24 h at the declared load with no solar input (proposed fixed-installation reference); record Wh, W and duty cycle; sensor terminal lifetime separately remains ≥1 year (RFP S3-04).
reqs.rationale: Keeps responder traffic available during night and tropical storms without requiring a hand crank for station loads.

reqs.name: Backhaul Path Health
reqs.statement: The ranger-station gateway shall evaluate availability of its configured terrestrial and satellite backhaul connections for route selection.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Detects communication failure and prevents indefinitely attempting a nonfunctional route.

reqs.name: Distress Initiation Control
reqs.statement: The responder terminal shall provide a distinguishable operator control for submitting a distress alert.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of the approved nominal, boundary and fault-injection functional test cases with logged inputs, outputs and acceptance decisions (proposed verification criterion).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Distress Originating Interface requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Distress Message Assembly
reqs.statement: The responder terminal shall create a distress message with its terminal identifier and submission time.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Distress Originating Interface requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Distress Destination Route
reqs.statement: The routing service shall forward distress messages to the configured coordination endpoint.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful end-to-end delivery of ≥100 valid messages per declared nominal route in the approved test suite; preserve payload and addressing (proposed lower-level allocation; RFP priority-message targets supersede where applicable).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Distress Routing requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Distress Delivery Receipt
reqs.statement: The coordination endpoint shall generate a reception record for a delivered distress message.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful end-to-end delivery of ≥100 valid messages per declared nominal route in the approved test suite; preserve payload and addressing (proposed lower-level allocation; RFP priority-message targets supersede where applicable).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Distress Routing requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Distress Priority Mark
reqs.statement: The terminal shall identify each originated distress message with the designated distress priority class.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Distress Identification requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Distress Class Preservation
reqs.statement: Each forwarding gateway shall preserve the marked distress priority class.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Distress Identification requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Position Input Validation
reqs.statement: The terminal shall reject invalid coordinates received from its configured location source.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Position Acquisition Interface requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Position Timestamp
reqs.statement: The terminal shall associate a position timestamp with each accepted location update.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% of approved event-to-event timing trials complete within ≤120 s under the declared nominal connected scenario (proposed); specify the start/end events and exclude satellite visibility wait only where explicitly stated.
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Position Acquisition Interface requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Location Message Routing
reqs.statement: The network shall route accepted responder position messages to the designated authorized endpoint.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Position Report Transport requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Location Message Identity
reqs.statement: The position report shall include the registered origin terminal identifier.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Position Report Transport requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Stale Fix Indicator
reqs.statement: The responder terminal shall flag a position estimate older than the configured validity interval.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% of approved event-to-event timing trials complete within ≤120 s under the declared nominal connected scenario (proposed); specify the start/end events and exclude satellite visibility wait only where explicitly stated.
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Location Validity Flag requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Position Unavailable Indicator
reqs.statement: The responder terminal shall identify location reports that do not contain a valid position fix.
reqs.threshold: Generate a correctly associated record for 100% of approved nominal and failure-injection events; record identifier, state and timestamp where applicable (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Location Validity Flag requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Delivery State Storage
reqs.statement: The message service shall store the current confirmed delivery state for each tracked responder message.
reqs.threshold: Demonstrate essential operation for ≥24 h at the declared load with no solar input (proposed fixed-installation reference); record Wh, W and duty cycle; sensor terminal lifetime separately remains ≥1 year (RFP S3-04).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Delivery Status Tracking requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Delivery State Update
reqs.statement: The message service shall update the tracked state upon receipt of a valid destination acknowledgment or delivery failure.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful end-to-end delivery of ≥100 valid messages per declared nominal route in the approved test suite; preserve payload and addressing (proposed lower-level allocation; RFP priority-message targets supersede where applicable).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Delivery Status Tracking requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Message Status Presentation
reqs.statement: The responder terminal shall display or audibly indicate the delivery state of a tracked outgoing message.
reqs.threshold: Generate a correctly associated record for 100% of approved nominal and failure-injection events; record identifier, state and timestamp where applicable (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Terminal Status Display requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Status Uncertainty Indication
reqs.statement: The responder terminal shall distinguish unconfirmed delivery from confirmed receipt.
reqs.threshold: Generate a correctly associated record for 100% of approved nominal and failure-injection events; record identifier, state and timestamp where applicable (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Terminal Status Display requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Distress Queue Scheduling
reqs.statement: The network scheduler shall select eligible distress packets ahead of routine sensor packets during congestion.
reqs.threshold: Retain 100% of accepted messages over a simulated 24 h onward-path outage at the declared peak arrival rate; verify ordered replay after recovery (proposed; overflow must be separately logged).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Distress Queue Priority requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Queue Contention Test
reqs.statement: The network scheduler shall demonstrate the configured emergency-before-routine service ordering under simulated contention.
reqs.threshold: Retain 100% of accepted messages over a simulated 24 h onward-path outage at the declared peak arrival rate; verify ordered replay after recovery (proposed; overflow must be separately logged).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Distress Queue Priority requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Relay Class Retention
reqs.statement: The relay node shall preserve the priority classification on forwarded responder distress messages.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Priority Preservation requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Gateway Class Retention
reqs.statement: The ground gateway shall preserve the priority classification on accepted responder distress messages.
reqs.threshold: Retain 100% of accepted messages over a simulated 24 h onward-path outage at the declared peak arrival rate; verify ordered replay after recovery (proposed; overflow must be separately logged).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Priority Preservation requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Portable Antenna Operation
reqs.statement: The responder terminal shall communicate through an approved portable antenna arrangement in its specified operating configuration.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of approved installation, fit, environmental and inspection checks for each declared site/mounting class; site wind loading and antenna clearance must be justified by site-specific structural analysis (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Mobile Terminal Link requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Portable Power Operation
reqs.statement: The responder terminal shall operate from its approved portable power source for the specified duty cycle.
reqs.threshold: Demonstrate the declared duty cycle and power budget over a representative ≥24 h profile; project battery life ≥1 year for sensor terminals (RFP S3-04); receiver off-grid supply must be solar OR hand-crank (RFP S3-07), as applicable.
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Mobile Terminal Link requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Link Loss Detection
reqs.statement: The responder terminal shall detect loss of its serving communications link.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of the approved nominal, boundary and fault-injection functional test cases with logged inputs, outputs and acceptance decisions (proposed verification criterion).
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Coverage Transition requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: Link Reacquisition
reqs.statement: The responder terminal shall attempt communications reacquisition when a supported communications link becomes available.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% of approved event-to-event timing trials complete within ≤120 s under the declared nominal connected scenario (proposed); specify the start/end events and exclude satellite visibility wait only where explicitly stated.
reqs.rationale: Allocates the Coverage Transition requirement to a verifiable function.

reqs.name: CAP ingest
reqs.statement: The ground segment shall validate and ingest CAP alerts issued by authorized national agencies.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct accept/reject, classification, identity preservation, or prioritization across the approved nominal, malformed and boundary-case test vectors (proposed verification acceptance).
reqs.rationale: Example: alert authority stays with national agencies (constraint).

reqs.name: Receiver plays alerts
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall play received alerts as audible speech.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of the approved nominal, boundary and fault-injection functional test cases with logged inputs, outputs and acceptance decisions (proposed verification criterion).
reqs.rationale: Legacy receiver playback example; overlaps with L2-2.3.1 and L3-2.3.2.2; candidate for consolidation after confirming downstream Level 4 links.

reqs.name: Broadcast relay
reqs.statement: The space segment shall relay geo-targeted alert broadcasts to community receivers.
reqs.threshold: Authorized alert targeting area ≤50,000 km²; objective ≤2,500 km² (RFP S3-06); test boundary cases against georeferenced reference polygons.
reqs.rationale: Example: allocation of the broadcast leg to the space segment.

reqs.name: Launch to orbit
reqs.statement: The launch segment shall deliver the space segment to its operational orbit (orbit TBD by trade study).
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of the approved nominal, boundary and fault-injection functional test cases with logged inputs, outputs and acceptance decisions (proposed verification criterion).
reqs.rationale: Launch-to-orbit is not a direct decomposition of tropical rain availability or service life. Requires placement under an appropriate system/space deployment parent after architecture selection.

reqs.name: Alert Timeline Measurement
reqs.statement: The end-to-end alert measurement service shall record elapsed time from authorized alert acceptance to confirmed receiver playback event.
reqs.threshold: Measure from authorized-alert acceptance timestamp to audible playback at each targeted receiver; ≤10 min for ≥95% of receivers, objective ≤3 min for ≥99% (RFP S3-05).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L2-S3-05.

reqs.name: Playback Event Capture
reqs.statement: The receiver test interface shall provide an observable indication when an authorized spoken alert begins playback.
reqs.threshold: Capture audible-playback event timestamp at 100% of receivers included in the verification sample; use these to verify ≤10 min for ≥95% (objective ≤3 min for ≥99%) (RFP S3-05).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L2-S3-05.

reqs.name: Target Area Limit
reqs.statement: The alert selection service shall define target regions no larger than the RFP threshold of 50,000 square kilometers.
reqs.threshold: Authorized alert targeting area ≤50,000 km²; objective ≤2,500 km² (RFP S3-06); test boundary cases against georeferenced reference polygons.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L2-S3-06.

reqs.name: Language Inventory
reqs.statement: The system alert library shall support French, Lingala, Kiswahili, Kikongo, and Tshiluba speech payloads.
reqs.threshold: Support French, Lingala, Kiswahili, Kikongo, and Tshiluba; objective ≥10 district-selected languages (RFP S3-06); verify each configured language.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L2-S3-06.

reqs.name: Fixed Antenna Interface
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall receive eligible satellite alert messages without antenna tracking or manual pointing.
reqs.threshold: Community receiver shall accept a fixed antenna without operator pointing and use solar OR hand-crank power; receiver unit cost ≤$25 (RFP S3-07); demonstrate installation without active pointing.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L2-S3-07.

reqs.name: Receiver Cost Allocation
reqs.statement: The community receiver design shall meet the specified unit-cost ceiling under the approved costing basis.
reqs.threshold: Document a costed bill of materials for 100% of the declared equipment configuration; comply with applicable RFP unit-cost cap (sensor ≤$150; community receiver ≤$25); proposed cost-accounting test.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L2-S3-07.

reqs.name: Terminal Capacity Allocation
reqs.statement: The responder communications network shall maintain at least 500 concurrent authorized responder terminals under the specified load test.
reqs.threshold: Support ≥500 simultaneous responder terminals at ≥4.8 kbps per terminal; objective ≥5,000 at ≥64 kbps (RFP S3-08); direction-specific rates must be declared in test configuration.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L2-S3-08.

reqs.name: Terminal Throughput Allocation
reqs.statement: The responder communications network shall provide at least 4.8 kbps per supported simultaneous terminal under the defined load test.
reqs.threshold: Support ≥500 simultaneous responder terminals at ≥4.8 kbps per terminal; objective ≥5,000 at ≥64 kbps (RFP S3-08); direction-specific rates must be declared in test configuration.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L2-S3-08.

reqs.name: Command Delay Budget
reqs.statement: The responder command service shall deliver addressed commands within the RFP six-hour maximum under defined operating conditions.
reqs.threshold: Deliver an addressed command/acknowledgment within ≤6 h; objective ≤15 min (RFP S3-09); measure from accepted request to terminal delivery.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L2-S3-09.

reqs.name: Acknowledgment Delay Budget
reqs.statement: The responder network shall deliver addressed acknowledgments within the RFP six-hour maximum under defined operating conditions.
reqs.threshold: Deliver an addressed command/acknowledgment within ≤6 h; objective ≤15 min (RFP S3-09); measure from accepted request to terminal delivery.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L2-S3-09.

reqs.name: Rain Availability Allocation
reqs.statement: The system shall achieve at least 99.5 percent communication service availability under the specified heavy tropical rain environment.
reqs.threshold: ≥99.5% system service availability in the declared heavy-tropical-rain test profile; objective ≥99.9% (RFP S3-10); calculate using declared service-time denominator and rainfall model.
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L2-S3-10.

reqs.name: Service Duration Allocation
reqs.statement: The system shall sustain required communications service for a minimum planned mission duration of 10 years.
reqs.threshold: ≥10 years service life by reliability/life-cycle analysis with stated maintenance assumptions; objective ≥15 years (RFP S3-10).
reqs.rationale: Derived capability allocated to support L2-S3-10.

reqs.name: Reporting Payload Allocation
reqs.statement: The configured sensor reporting profile shall deliver the allocated routine application payload over each 24-hour interval.
reqs.threshold: ≥2,000 bytes per terminal per day (decimal kB interpretation of RFP S3-02; confirm unit convention).
reqs.rationale: Connects configurable cadence to the minimum RFP data volume.

reqs.name: Terminal Standby Current
reqs.statement: The sensor terminal shall draw no more than its allocated standby current while in the reduced-power state.
reqs.threshold: Demonstrate the declared duty cycle and power budget over a representative ≥24 h profile; project battery life ≥1 year for sensor terminals (RFP S3-04); receiver off-grid supply must be solar OR hand-crank (RFP S3-07), as applicable.
reqs.rationale: Standby energy can dominate long-life low-reporting-rate deployments.

reqs.name: Timed Wake Accuracy
reqs.statement: The sensor controller shall initiate a scheduled communication opportunity within its allocated timing tolerance.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% of approved event-to-event timing trials complete within ≤120 s under the declared nominal connected scenario (proposed); specify the start/end events and exclude satellite visibility wait only where explicitly stated.
reqs.rationale: Limits unnecessary radio-on time and missed contact opportunities.

reqs.name: RF Transmit Energy Allocation
reqs.statement: The terminal radio shall remain within the maximum transmission energy allocated to each delivered routine message under the reference link profile.
reqs.threshold: Demonstrate essential operation for ≥24 h at the declared load with no solar input (proposed fixed-installation reference); record Wh, W and duty cycle; sensor terminal lifetime separately remains ≥1 year (RFP S3-04).
reqs.rationale: Binds transmit design to the lifetime requirement without selecting a radio prematurely.

reqs.name: Canopy Attenuation Assumption
reqs.statement: Each representative link budget shall state the modeled excess vegetation attenuation for the applicable sensor-to-relay propagation path.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Forest attenuation cannot be assigned a universal value without site and band assumptions.

reqs.name: Canopy Received Signal Margin
reqs.statement: The selected under-canopy radio interface shall meet its allocated minimum received-power margin at the designated vegetation and terrain test conditions.
reqs.threshold: ≥6 dB received-signal margin at ≥90% of defined under-canopy test points (proposed allocation); field measurements required.
reqs.rationale: Example 900 MHz, 2 km radio path yields ~16.4 dB margin with assumed 20 dB vegetation loss, but ~1.4 dB at 35 dB vegetation loss, for −120 dBm sensitivity. Test multiple canopy depths before fixing coverage claims.

reqs.name: Minimum Payload Throughput
reqs.statement: The capacity budget shall include at least 160 Mbit of routine application payload over each 24-hour reporting period.
reqs.threshold: ≥160 Mbit/day (10,000 terminals × 2,000 bytes × 8 bits).
reqs.rationale: Direct arithmetic allocation of RFP S3-02 minimum volume; overhead excluded.

reqs.name: Protocol Overhead Factor
reqs.statement: The capacity analysis shall distinguish application-payload throughput from additional protocol, acknowledgment, and retransmission traffic.
reqs.threshold: Provision aggregate transport capacity ≥2.0 × application-layer average offered load for the declared protocol and retransmission model (proposed planning factor; validate against measured overhead).
reqs.rationale: Prevents equating message payload volume with raw RF capacity.

reqs.name: Average Baseline Data Rate
reqs.statement: The communications capacity analysis shall demonstrate sufficient aggregate application-payload throughput to carry the minimum RFP sensor reporting volume over the allocated available network contact time.
reqs.threshold: ≥160 Mbit of sensor application data transported per 24 h for 10,000 × 2 kB/day; average 1.852 kbps application throughput (RFP S3-02, decimal kB assumption). Objective 100,000 × 50 kB/day = 40 Gbit/day, average 463 kbps before overhead.
reqs.rationale: For illustration only, 10% aggregate effective contact opportunity, 50% payload efficiency and a peak factor of 3 imply 1.852 kbps × 3 / (0.10 × 0.50) ≈111.1 kbps peak raw capacity. Avoid equating daily application average with RF air-interface throughput.

reqs.name: Terrestrial Radio Link Budget
reqs.statement: The terrestrial sensor-link design shall achieve the allocated receiver-input margin at the design range and specified vegetation, terrain, and equipment loss conditions.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Using FSPL = 32.44 + 20log10(f_MHz) + 20log10(d_km), reference FSPL = 97.55 dB. With assumed −120 dBm receiver sensitivity, margin ≈16.4 dB at 20 dB vegetation loss, but ≈1.4 dB at 35 dB loss. This illustrates sensitivity to canopy and does not justify a chosen radio band or deployment radius.

reqs.name: Terrestrial Link Field Trial
reqs.statement: The terrestrial sensor radio interface shall be tested at designated canopy-depth and distance combinations with recorded packet delivery ratio and received signal level.
reqs.threshold: ≥100 test messages at each of ≥10 representative canopy/terrain sites; ≥95% valid payload delivery at sites included in the proposed supported-service footprint (proposed sampling plan).
reqs.rationale: Field characterization is required to validate the propagation trade and translate simulated coverage into deployable repeater placement.

reqs.name: Relay Reception Verification
reqs.statement: The repeater receiver shall validate sensor-message reception under the reference RF test profile.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful reception across ≥100 messages per approved terrestrial-relay test site, under defined operating conditions (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Verifies terrestrial ingress as a measured interface.

reqs.name: Satellite Backhaul Capacity
reqs.statement: The ranger gateway satellite interface shall carry its allocated aggregate data and responder traffic under the approved service profile.
reqs.threshold: ≥95% successful delivery of ≥100 valid test messages per declared supported link scenario, with ≥6 dB calculated link margin where applicable (proposed; actual waveform, band and propagation conditions must be declared).
reqs.rationale: Avoids assuming all station capacity is available to routine telemetry.

reqs.name: Station Battery Autonomy
reqs.statement: The ranger-station energy-storage subsystem shall supply the designated essential communications load for the allocated solar-unavailable autonomy duration without external charging.
reqs.threshold: ≥24 h essential-load autonomy at end-of-life battery capacity; nominal Wh ≥ 24 × essential W /(0.8 allowable DoD × 0.8 EOL capacity × 0.9 discharge efficiency) (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Illustration: 30 W × 24 h /(0.80 × 0.80 × 0.90) = 1,250 Wh nominal battery storage. The 30 W load and derating factors are trade-study assumptions, not measured site data.

reqs.name: Station Energy Balance
reqs.statement: The ranger-station photovoltaic system shall generate sufficient usable daily energy to supply essential station loads under the adopted design-month solar resource after specified PV-system losses.
reqs.threshold: Daily photovoltaic energy ≥1.25 × essential-load daily Wh in the design month; array Wp ≥1.25 × 24 × essential W /(design peak-sun-hours × net PV yield) (proposed; irradiance must be site-verified).
reqs.rationale: Illustration: 30 W × 24 h /(3 h/day × 0.65) = 369.2 Wp. Field shading/seasonal solar resource must be checked; PV capacity for recovery after multiple cloudy days is a separate allocation.

reqs.name: Station Battery Recharge Recovery
reqs.statement: The ranger-station energy subsystem shall replenish its designated battery reserve within the allocated recovery interval under specified solar-resource conditions.
reqs.threshold: Restore battery state of charge from the minimum operational reserve to ≥80% within ≤3 consecutive design-month solar days while sustaining essential load (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Daily load coverage is not equivalent to restoring energy depleted during a prolonged outage.

reqs.name: Antenna Height Allocation
reqs.statement: The ranger-station backhaul antenna shall be mounted at the site-specific height established by the selected line-of-sight, obstruction-clearance, structural, and serviceability analyses.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of approved installation, fit, environmental and inspection checks for each declared site/mounting class; site wind loading and antenna clearance must be justified by site-specific structural analysis (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Local canopy height alone does not fix antenna height: local terrain, satellite look-angle, terrestrial backhaul Fresnel clearance, structural wind loads, and accessible maintenance determine siting.

reqs.name: Antenna Structure Loads
reqs.statement: An elevated ranger-station antenna installation shall withstand the site design wind loading in its installed configuration.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of approved installation, fit, environmental and inspection checks for each declared site/mounting class; site wind loading and antenna clearance must be justified by site-specific structural analysis (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Remote towers and tree mounts require site-specific structural assessment.

reqs.name: Backhaul Antenna Access
reqs.statement: The installed ranger-station antenna support shall provide a maintainable antenna access or replacement method consistent with the site installation plan.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of approved installation, fit, environmental and inspection checks for each declared site/mounting class; site wind loading and antenna clearance must be justified by site-specific structural analysis (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Remote stations need an affordable servicing strategy when elevated antennas or cables fail.

reqs.name: Station Queue Persistence
reqs.statement: The ranger gateway shall retain queued sensor message contents across a loss and restoration of external electrical input within its specified backup-power envelope.
reqs.threshold: Retain 100% of queued test messages through a 24 h controlled power interruption, subject to provisioned nonvolatile storage capacity (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Tests buffering at a particularly realistic failure point.

reqs.name: Repeater Battery Autonomy
reqs.statement: The permanent repeater energy-storage subsystem shall power essential relay receiving, forwarding and control functions throughout the allocated period without photovoltaic generation.
reqs.threshold: ≥24 h essential-load autonomy at end-of-life battery capacity; nominal Wh ≥ 24 × essential W /(0.8 × 0.8 × 0.9) (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Illustration: 8 W × 24 h /(0.80 × 0.80 × 0.90) = 333.3 Wh nominal storage; the 8 W assumed load must be verified against chosen radios and duty cycle.

reqs.name: Repeater Solar Energy Balance
reqs.statement: The permanent repeater photovoltaic supply shall satisfy the design-day energy demand of its essential radio and controller loads after system losses.
reqs.threshold: Daily photovoltaic energy ≥1.25 × essential-load daily Wh in the design month; array Wp ≥1.25 × 24 × essential W /(design peak-sun-hours × net PV yield) (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Illustrative 8 W relay continuously powered; PV power is sensitive to shade and worst-month resource.

reqs.name: Repeater Mount Adaptability
reqs.statement: The repeater enclosure and antenna assembly shall attach to the approved mechanical mounting interface defined for its installation class.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of approved installation, fit, environmental and inspection checks for each declared site/mounting class; site wind loading and antenna clearance must be justified by site-specific structural analysis (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Permits towers where canopy height or weather makes simpler mounts unsuitable.

reqs.name: Repeater Queue Capacity
reqs.statement: A designated buffering repeater shall retain the maximum number of messages accepted during its allocated onward-link outage without overwriting unexpired priority messages.
reqs.threshold: Store ≥24 h of the repeater’s peak assigned message arrival load with ≥25% additional queue headroom (proposed); calculate count from site-specific arrival model.
reqs.rationale: A 100-message buffer may be insufficient for a busy repeater: a sample design with 200 terminals sending twenty 100-byte payloads per day produces 4,000 messages in 24 h. Packet metadata and queue policy require separate allocation.

reqs.name: Repeater Message Memory Allocation
reqs.statement: The repeater message store shall provide sufficient nonvolatile memory for accepted messages over its allocated outage period, including payload, identifiers, timestamps and queue metadata.
reqs.threshold: Provision nonvolatile bytes ≥1.25 × (24 h peak accepted messages) × (maximum configured payload bytes + metadata bytes), including protocol storage overhead (proposed).
reqs.rationale: This is a worked sizing example; the 40 B metadata allocation is illustrative.

reqs.name: Alert Air Interface Budget
reqs.statement: The satellite-to-receiver air interface shall complete delivery of an accepted alert payload within its allocated active-link interval.
reqs.threshold: ≤2 min from initiation of an available satellite downlink service opportunity to valid payload reception at the addressed receiver; preliminary allocation inside the 4 min relay budget; excludes waiting for contact.
reqs.rationale: Ensures space-segment delay is budgeted rather than inheriting the entire latency allowance.

reqs.name: Spoken Payload Duration
reqs.statement: The speech playback chain shall reproduce the complete designated alert audio without truncation at the maximum supported alert duration.
reqs.threshold: Support a spoken-alert payload of ≥60 s in each required language without truncation; proposed minimum message-duration capability.
reqs.rationale: Audio design must preserve complete emergency instructions.

reqs.name: Receiver Output Sound Level
reqs.statement: The audio output shall achieve the specified speech sound pressure level at the designated listener location.
reqs.threshold: ≥75 dBA A-weighted sound level at 1 m on-axis during the reference spoken test signal, measured in a quiet environment (proposed device-level target; not a community-wide audibility claim).
reqs.rationale: A 25-dollar personal receiver and outdoor PA station require different acoustic allocations.

reqs.name: Outdoor Acoustic Coverage
reqs.statement: The installed public-address subsystem shall reproduce intelligible warning speech within the surveyed target listening area.
reqs.threshold: Demonstrate speech intelligibility at ≥1 designated listener point per community deployment using a documented ambient-noise profile; acoustic radius must be established by site study (proposed verification scope).
reqs.rationale: Outdoor siren/loudspeaker sizing must respond to site geometry, not a handheld receiver specification.

reqs.name: Antenna Pointing Independence
reqs.statement: The community receiver antenna shall decode the specified satellite alert signal without mechanically steering the antenna.
reqs.threshold: No mechanical tracking or pointing (RFP S3-07).
reqs.rationale: Preserves user simplicity and low cost in remote settlements.

reqs.name: Community Receiver Reserve Energy
reqs.statement: The solar receiver storage unit shall retain sufficient usable energy to receive and play one complete maximum-duration alert after the designated no-sun interval.
reqs.threshold: Receiver shall support ≥3 consecutive 60 s alert playbacks without grid power under the declared solar OR crank operating scenario (proposed duty-cycle test).
reqs.rationale: Links storage selection to an emergency functional event.

reqs.name: Return Uplink Payload
reqs.statement: The acknowledgment return-link message shall include an alert identifier and receiver identifier.
reqs.threshold: Both identifiers present in all accepted acknowledgment messages.
reqs.rationale: Allows reception confirmation to be tied to a specific alert and community receiver.

reqs.name: Responder Uplink Data Rate
reqs.statement: The responder radio interface shall support its allocated user bit rate under the approved simultaneous-access scenario.
reqs.threshold: Support ≥500 simultaneous responder terminals at ≥4.8 kbps per terminal; objective ≥5,000 at ≥64 kbps (RFP S3-08); direction-specific rates must be declared in test configuration.
reqs.rationale: Allocates minimum user-throughput requirement without assuming an RF modulation or channel bandwidth.

reqs.name: Responder Downlink Data Rate
reqs.statement: The responder radio interface shall support receipt of the allocated downlink user data rate under the approved operating scenario.
reqs.threshold: Support ≥500 simultaneous responder terminals at ≥4.8 kbps per terminal; objective ≥5,000 at ≥64 kbps (RFP S3-08); direction-specific rates must be declared in test configuration.
reqs.rationale: Two-way connectivity requires explicit downlink feasibility.

reqs.name: Rain Fade Allowance
reqs.statement: The relevant RF link budget shall specify a rain attenuation margin consistent with the assigned link availability.
reqs.threshold: ≥99.5% system service availability in the declared heavy-tropical-rain test profile; objective ≥99.9% (RFP S3-10); calculate using declared service-time denominator and rainfall model.
reqs.rationale: Rain attenuation is dependent on frequency, location and elevation angle.

reqs.name: Ground Enclosure Protection
reqs.statement: An outdoor repeater or gateway enclosure shall withstand the specified site rainfall and humidity exposure without loss of essential communications function.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of approved installation, fit, environmental and inspection checks for each declared site/mounting class; site wind loading and antenna clearance must be justified by site-specific structural analysis (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Supports rain service reliability through hardware protection.

reqs.name: Failover Detection Time
reqs.statement: The ranger gateway shall identify a failed primary backhaul and initiate its alternate-path procedure within the allocated detection interval.
reqs.threshold: Detect active-path failure within ≤30 s for ≥95% of declared detectable-failure test cases (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Establishes a verifiable component of outage recovery.

reqs.name: Essential Communications Load
reqs.statement: The station power budget shall separately account for the essential satellite modem, gateway and network-control loads during outage operation.
reqs.threshold: Essential-load usable battery capacity ≥24 × measured essential W (Wh), with nameplate sizing adjusted for DoD, efficiency and end-of-life capacity (proposed 24 h autonomy).
reqs.rationale: Makes autonomous operation and associated cost calculable.

reqs.name: Alternate Path Probe
reqs.statement: The ranger gateway shall identify a configured satellite backhaul as available only after a successful communications health check.
reqs.threshold: Test availability of configured alternate paths at intervals ≤30 s while a session is active, unless probing would violate an allocated power budget (proposed).
reqs.rationale: Avoids failing over to a satellite path that is also unavailable.

reqs.name: Receiver loudness
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall produce speech at a sound level of TBD dB at TBD m.
reqs.threshold: Pass 100% of the approved nominal, boundary and fault-injection functional test cases with logged inputs, outputs and acceptance decisions (proposed verification criterion).
reqs.rationale: Example: placeholder value; set by analysis.

reqs.name: Receiver power
reqs.statement: The community receiver shall operate from solar or hand-crank power.
reqs.threshold: Demonstrate the declared duty cycle and power budget over a representative ≥24 h profile; project battery life ≥1 year for sensor terminals (RFP S3-04); receiver off-grid supply must be solar OR hand-crank (RFP S3-07), as applicable.
reqs.rationale: Example: derived from S3-07 (solar or crank).

reqs.name: Collect
reqs.statement: Collect short messages from thousands of low-power gauges, sensors, wildlife tags, and ranger devices anywhere in the basin, including under canopy.

reqs.name: Warn
reqs.statement: Broadcast geo-targeted, spoken alerts to every community and confirm delivery.

reqs.name: Coordinate
reqs.statement: Give rangers and responders two-way communications that survive loss of terrestrial networks.

reqs.name: Environmental Hazard Assessment
reqs.statement: The environmental assessment subsystem shall retrieve and evaluate relevant environmental observations and provide authorized decision-makers with an evidence-based hazard assessment and alert recommendation.
reqs.threshold: For 100% of approved representative test scenarios, produce an assessment with source references, threshold results, correlation results, severity, affected location, and recommendation state.
reqs.rationale: Closes the functional gap between data processing (F3) and alert generation (F5) without mandating autonomous alert issuance.

reqs.name: Relevant Data Retrieval and Screening
reqs.statement: The environmental assessment subsystem shall retrieve observations from configured environmental data sources and identify invalid or stale observations before hazard evaluation.
reqs.threshold: Retrieve records from every configured source in the approved integration test; correctly flag 100% of invalid and stale test observations using source-specific validity and age rules.
reqs.rationale: Prevents stale or corrupted observations from being treated as current evidence of hazardous conditions.

reqs.name: Environmental Threshold Comparison
reqs.statement: The environmental assessment subsystem shall compare eligible environmental measurements with approved hazard thresholds applicable to their measurement type and location.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct below/at/above-threshold classifications in approved boundary tests; log threshold identifier, value, units, operator, and rule version.
reqs.rationale: Provides reproducible and auditable hazard-condition screening without prescribing hydrologic thresholds before a hazard study.

reqs.name: Multi-Source Observation Correlation
reqs.statement: The environmental assessment subsystem shall correlate eligible observations from multiple configured data sources using approved temporal and geographic association rules.
reqs.threshold: Correctly associate or reject 100% of observations in the approved matched, mismatched, and missing-source test cases; record contributing source IDs and time/location offsets.
reqs.rationale: Transforms measurement comparisons into actionable condition assessments while leaving category definitions to the hazard concept of operations.

reqs.name: Hazard Severity and Location Assessment
reqs.statement: The environmental assessment subsystem shall determine the configured hazard severity category and affected geographic area from the evaluated observations and approved assessment rules.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct severity categories and geographic area assignments in the approved reference scenarios; record severity rule and georeferenced affected-area identifier.
reqs.rationale: Establishes a traceable F4-to-F5 interface; authorization and actual broadcasting remain governed by F5/F6 requirements.

reqs.name: Threshold Configuration Control
reqs.statement: The environmental assessment service shall accept warning-rule configuration changes only from authorized operators and retain the active rule version used for each evaluation.
reqs.threshold: Reject 100% of unauthorized configuration attempts in the approved negative-test suite; each evaluation record references exactly one active rule version.
reqs.rationale: Protects integrity and repeatability of environmental threshold decisions.

reqs.name: Correlation Evidence Record
reqs.statement: The environmental assessment service shall record the input observations and association criteria used in each multi-source correlation result.
reqs.threshold: Each approved correlation record includes source and observation IDs, observation timestamps, geographic references, association rule version, and correlation outcome.
reqs.rationale: Provides auditable cross-source correlation evidence for decision-makers.

reqs.name: Alert Necessity Recommendation
reqs.statement: The environmental assessment subsystem shall recommend whether an alert is warranted based on the approved hazard assessment criteria and shall present the supporting evidence to authorized decision-makers.
reqs.threshold: For 100% of approved normal, uncertain, and warning-eligible test scenarios, produce the expected recommend / do-not-recommend / insufficient-evidence state and supporting rationale; no automatic authorization.
reqs.rationale: Derived from F4 Evaluate Conditions: support organizational hazard assessment and informed alert decisions; numerical test-suite acceptance is preliminary.

reqs.name: Assessment Handoff to Alert Generation
reqs.statement: The environmental assessment subsystem shall make its completed assessment and recommendation available to authorized decision-makers and the alert-generation function without initiating an alert broadcast.
reqs.threshold: 100% of approved test assessments transferred with matching assessment ID, severity, affected area, source references, timestamp, and recommendation state; receipt logged.
reqs.rationale: Derived from F4 Evaluate Conditions: support organizational hazard assessment and informed alert decisions; numerical test-suite acceptance is preliminary.

reqs.name: Observation Eligibility
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall determine whether each retrieved observation is eligible for hazard evaluation using the approved source validity and freshness rules.
reqs.threshold: Classify 100% of approved valid, invalid, missing-timestamp and expired-observation test vectors correctly.
reqs.rationale: Ensure hazard conclusions use eligible evidence.

reqs.name: Severity and Footprint Computation
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall compute a hazard severity category and affected-area identifier using the active approved hazard assessment rules.
reqs.threshold: Match 100% of the expected severity and affected-area outputs in approved reference scenarios.
reqs.rationale: Make the severity and geography determination reproducible.

reqs.name: Decision Support Recommendation
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall derive an alert recommendation and evidence summary from the evaluated hazard conditions without authorizing transmission.
reqs.threshold: Match expected recommend, do-not-recommend, and insufficient-evidence outputs in 100% of approved scenarios.
reqs.rationale: Keep decision support distinct from alert authorization.

reqs.name: Assessment Transfer Record
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall transmit a structured assessment record to the authorized review interface and preserve an acknowledgment of receipt.
reqs.threshold: 100% of approved test records are delivered with matching identifiers, content, and receipt log entries.
reqs.rationale: Provide a testable F4-to-F5 interface.

reqs.name: Observation Timestamp Validation
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall reject an observation from current-condition evaluation when its acquisition timestamp is absent or cannot be interpreted in the configured time reference.
reqs.threshold: Reject 100% of missing, malformed and unsupported-timestamp test cases.
reqs.rationale: Prevents untraceable measurements from influencing current assessments.

reqs.name: Observation Freshness Check
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall flag observations whose age exceeds the active source-specific maximum-age rule.
reqs.threshold: Correctly flag 100% of test observations immediately below, at, and above each configured age limit.
reqs.rationale: Freshness limits depend on source sampling cadence and hazard model.

reqs.name: Authorized Rule Modification
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall prevent an unauthenticated or unauthorized operator from modifying an active hazard threshold rule.
reqs.threshold: Reject 100% of unauthorized change attempts in the approved security test suite and retain the original active rule.
reqs.rationale: Protects evaluation criteria from unauthorized changes.

reqs.name: Rule Version Audit
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall associate each completed threshold evaluation with the unique version identifier of the rule set applied.
reqs.threshold: 100% of approved evaluation records identify the rule version that was active when the evaluation ran.
reqs.rationale: Allows reproducible threshold comparison.

reqs.name: Temporal Correlation Record
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall record the observation times and time separation for every accepted or rejected temporal association.
reqs.threshold: 100% of approved association records contain both observation timestamps, calculated offset, and applied temporal-window identifier.
reqs.rationale: Makes cross-source timing comparisons auditable.

reqs.name: Geographic Correlation Record
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall record the georeferenced source locations and geographic-association outcome for each multi-source correlation.
reqs.threshold: 100% of approved correlation records include source location identifiers, applied spatial rule identifier, and association result.
reqs.rationale: Makes the geographic basis of hazard assessment traceable.

reqs.name: Severity Rule Application
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall assign the hazard severity category specified by the active approved rule set for each evaluated reference scenario.
reqs.threshold: 100% agreement with approved severity labels, including boundary and no-hazard cases.
reqs.rationale: Avoids inventing unsupported physical flood-stage thresholds.

reqs.name: Affected-Area Identification
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall associate each identified hazard with an approved georeferenced affected-area identifier or an explicit location-unknown state.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct geographic identifiers or location-unknown flags in approved reference scenarios.
reqs.rationale: Supports geographic targeting without implying unsupported localization accuracy.

reqs.name: Insufficient Evidence State
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall output an insufficient-evidence recommendation when the approved decision rules cannot be evaluated because required observations are missing, invalid or contradictory.
reqs.threshold: 100% correct insufficient-evidence results in approved missing-source and conflicting-source cases.
reqs.rationale: Prevents unwarranted certainty.

reqs.name: Recommendation Evidence Summary
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall include the applied rule version, contributing observation identifiers, severity category, affected-area identifier, and uncertainty status in each recommendation record.
reqs.threshold: 100% of approved recommendation records contain all mandatory fields, with explicit unavailable markers where data is absent.
reqs.rationale: Enables an organization to review the evidence.

reqs.name: Assessment Identifier Preservation
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall preserve the originating assessment identifier unchanged when transferring an assessment to the authorized review interface.
reqs.threshold: 100% identifier match between sent and received records in approved interface tests.
reqs.rationale: Maintains traceability between evaluation and review.

reqs.name: Review Interface Receipt Logging
reqs.statement: The assessment service shall record the delivery result and receipt timestamp for each assessment transfer to the authorized review interface.
reqs.threshold: 100% of approved successful and failed transfer test cases generate a correctly associated status and timestamp record.
reqs.rationale: Supports monitoring without treating assessment transfer as alert authorization.
